title: PermissionRuleImportPreview
description: `POST /permission-rules/import/preview`: one verdict per item of an import file — `new`, `existing`, or `invalid` with the code that would refuse it (plan 15, B-18, D-17). Read only — nothing is written, and a `project` item's path is not resolved yet (no `folderMap` until applying).

digest.description: Of the file's own bytes — sent back on apply, to prove it is the same file (S-143).

code.description: Present for `invalid` — the code applying this item would answer with.
